method: Browser OfflineAudioContext at 44100 Hz, stereo, rendering the actual DerbyAudio implementation and committed MP3 assets through a real audio-node graph. A small adapter replaces only real-time context state/resume/close during offline rendering.
browserChecks: Both sound controls default off on a fresh page.
A user click unlocks, fetches, decodes, and enables the committed clips.
Toolbar and race-stage mute controls stay synchronized.
A complete nine-person round reaches its original final result with sound enabled.
Refreshing the finished round keeps its winner and resets sound off.
